summary: Lifezone Metals Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of warrants to purchase 500,000 ordinary shares at $6.25 per share to Taurus Mining Finance in connection with a waiver of a $60 million bridge loan facility. This is an ancillary equity-linked issuance (warrants) tied to a debt modification, not a standalone special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of an equity-linked inducement in a debt context, lacking the structural features of a transformative corporate event. There are no deal terms to report as no merger, tender, or similar transaction is involved.
